history.dynasty: Desais of Rivona patronage; Gowda Saraswat Brahmin (GSB) community; under Gokarna Partagali Jeevottam Math
history.summary: The deity originally stood in Mathagram (Margao), where the Holy Spirit Church now stands; the temple was destroyed during the Portuguese temple-destruction campaign in Sasashti taluka (1565/1567) and the Mahajans of Madgaon shifted Damodar with Ramnath, Lakshmi Narayan, Chamundeshwari, Mahakali and Mahesh to Zambaulim, where the Desais of Rivona granted land. Oral tradition holds the rescued Shiva linga's upper portion was carried to Zambaulim; legend says the temple commemorates a native, Makaji Damodar. Both Hindus and Catholics revere the deity. CSV CORRECTION: actual town is Zambaulim (Quepem taluka), NOT Margao — town/district corrected. POSSIBLE DUPLICATE: CSV rows 226 (Shree Damodar Temple, Vasco da Gama) and 229 (Damodar Temple, Margao) very likely describe this same famous temple; investigate and dedup.

name: Shri Damodar Temple
town_description: Zambaulim is a small village in Quepem taluka, South Goa, about 22 km from Margao, set on the banks of the Kushawati River whose waters devotees believe have healing properties. Each year the village hosts the Gulalotsav, Goa's largest Holi celebration, drawing thousands of Margao families home.

travel.road: About 22 km from Margao on the border of Quepem taluka; free lunch for devotees after the 12:30 PM aarti

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; visit during Shigmo (February–March) for the week-long Gulalotsav
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM – 8:30 PM (one travel source lists 5:30 AM – 9:45 PM — verify)
